name: li
summary: 将立即数装入整数寄存器（手册示例名称）。
summaryEn: Load an immediate into an integer register (name used in manual examples).
notes: 手册示例使用 li 设置整数值，但未给出针对任意常量和 XLEN 的完整汇编器展开规则；此处仅保留名称和来源，不猜测指令序列。
notesEn: The manual uses li to set integer values but does not define a complete assembler expansion for arbitrary constants and XLENs. This entry records the name and source without guessing a sequence.
